items.title: [Bug]: dynamicEfMin > dynamicEfMax accepted during collection creation (no validation)

probe_cases.desc: Create collection with vectorIndexConfig.dynamicEfMin=500 and dynamicEfMax=10 (min > max). Also retrieve config to confirm stored values.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of POST /v1/schema; then GET /v1/schema/TestEfBad and read vectorIndexConfig.dynamicEfMin / dynamicEfMax

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 with message that dynamicEfMin must be <= dynamicEfMax. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 and stores efMin=500, efMax=10.
items.contract_hint: HNSW dynamic ef range requires min <= max; other vectorIndexConfig params are already validated (e.g. maxConnections=0 -> 422).

items.title: [Bug]: flatSearchCutoff accepts negative values (no validation)

probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of POST /v1/schema; then GET /v1/schema/TestFC and read vectorIndexConfig.flatSearchCutoff

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 with message that flatSearchCutoff must be >= 0. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 and stores flatSearchCutoff=-100.
items.contract_hint: flatSearchCutoff is a threshold to switch between flat and approximate search; negative has no meaningful interpretation.

items.title: [Bug]: replicationFactor=-1 accepted and silently normalized to 1 (no validation)

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 with message that replicationFactor must be >= 1. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 and silently stores factor=1 (normalized from -1).
items.contract_hint: replication factor must be a positive integer >= 1; negative value is semantically invalid.

items.title: [Bug]: bq.rescoreLimit=-1 accepted and silently discarded (no validation)

items.contract_hint: bq rescoreLimit must be a non-negative count; invalid value should be caught at schema validation.

items.title: [Schema Validation] Negative `ef` value (-1) accepted in vectorIndexConfig without validation error

probe_cases.desc: Create collection with vectorIndexConfig.ef=-1 (negative HNSW search width).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of POST /v1/schema; (optional GET /v1/schema/TestEfneg to confirm stored ef)

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because ef (HNSW search width) must be a positive integer. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 creates collection with ef=-1.
items.contract_hint: HNSW ef governs size of dynamic nearest-neighbor list; must be a positive integer.

items.title: Negative `ef` value (-1) accepted in vectorIndexConfig without validation error

probe_cases.desc: Create collection with vectorIndexConfig.ef=-1. Repeat to capture the server's current behavior (this issue is labeled by-design).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of POST /v1/schema; record whether 200 accepted or 422 rejected

items.expectation: Issue is BY_DESIGN: server intentionally accepts ef=-1 with HTTP 200 (per maintainer). Probe records the actual accepted behavior rather than asserting a fix.
items.contract_hint: BY_DESIGN duplicate of #11433; maintainers accepted negative ef, so probe verifies current behavior.

items.title: REST API GET /v1/objects silently accepts negative limit parameter

probe_cases.desc: GET /v1/objects?limit=-1. Expect bug: HTTP 200 and empty result; correct: 4xx.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status code and body

items.expectation: Expected a 4xx validation error for negative limit. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 with {"deprecations":null,"objects":[]}.
items.contract_hint: OpenAPI documents limit as integer max 10000 (QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS); a non-negative invariant is implied. GraphQL path validates limit; REST list endpoint does not.
items.manual_reason: No objects inserted; negative-limit behavior may depend on whether any objects exist in the collection (empty vs non-empty result set).

items.title: REST API GET /v1/objects returns HTTP 500 instead of 4xx when limit exceeds QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS

probe_cases.desc: GET /v1/objects?limit=10001 (over default QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS=10000).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status code and body; expect 500 with 'query maximum results exceeded' in message

items.expectation: Expected 4xx (400/422) because over-cap limit is a client validation error. Actual (bug): HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with informative message.
items.contract_hint: Docs state 'If the sum of offset and limit exceeds QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS, Weaviate returns an error' - should be a 4xx not 5xx.

items.title: shardingConfig.desiredCount accepts negative values but rejects zero

probe_cases.desc: Control: desiredCount=0 should be rejected with 422 (proves validation exists).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 422)

probe_cases.desc: Bug: desiredCount=-1 (negative) is accepted with 200.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug)

items.expectation: ALL non-positive desiredCount values should be rejected with 422 (must be >= 1). Actual (bug): desiredCount=0 -> 422, but desiredCount=-1 -> 200.
items.contract_hint: Shard count must be a positive integer >= 1; 0 already rejected proving field is validated, negative must be too.

items.title: tokenization accepts empty string despite explicit OpenAPI enum constraint

probe_cases.desc: Create class with property tokenization set to empty string "" (not in OpenAPI enum).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and whether class created

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422: tokenization must be one of word, lowercase, whitespace, field, trigram, gse, kagome_kr, kagome_ja, gse_ch. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 creates class with empty tokenization.
items.contract_hint: OpenAPI schema.json Property.tokenization defines an explicit enum of 9 values; empty string not among them.

items.title: replicationConfig.deletionStrategy accepts empty string outside explicit OpenAPI enum

probe_cases.desc: Create class with replicationConfig.deletionStrategy="" (empty string, not in enum).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and whether class created with empty deletionStrategy

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422: deletionStrategy must be one of NoAutomatedResolution, DeleteOnConflict, TimeBasedResolution. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 creates class with empty deletionStrategy.
items.contract_hint: OpenAPI schema.json ReplicationConfig.deletionStrategy has enum of 3 values; empty string not among them.

items.title: vectorIndexConfig.distance silently accepts null and defaults to cosine

probe_cases.desc: Create class with vectorIndexConfig.distance=null.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug); then GET /v1/schema/TestClass and read vectorIndexConfig.distance (expect 'cosine')

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because null is not a valid distance metric. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 silently defaults to "cosine" - a silent data corruption risk when user intended dot/hamming etc.
items.contract_hint: Valid distances are cosine, dot, l2-squared, hamming, manhattan (docs). Server rejects other strings (e.g. 'foobar' -> 'unrecognized distance metric') but accepts null.

items.title: multiTenancyConfig accepts null for boolean fields autoTenantCreation and autoTenantActivation

probe_cases.desc: Create class with multiTenancyConfig.autoTenantCreation=null and autoTenantActivation=null (boolean fields set to null).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug); then GET /v1/schema/TestClass and read multiTenancyConfig

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because null is not a valid JSON boolean (only true/false accepted per OpenAPI type:boolean). Actual (bug): HTTP 200 creates class with null boolean fields.
items.contract_hint: OpenAPI schema.json MultiTenancyConfig.autoTenantCreation/autoTenantActivation are type boolean; null violates JSON Schema boolean type.

items.title: int64 boundary value 9223372036854775807 silently truncated to 9223372036854776000

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with an int property.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of schema creation

probe_cases.desc: Insert object with int_field=9223372036854775807 (math.MaxInt64), then GET it back to compare stored value.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status; then GET /v1/objects/TestClass/<id> and read properties.int_field

probe_cases.desc: Verify whether retrieved int_field equals 9223372036854775807 exactly or is rounded to 9223372036854776000.
probe_cases.observe: properties.int_field value in its JSON serialization

items.expectation: Expected int_field stored and returned exactly as 9223372036854775807 (int is int64). Actual (bug): 200 but stored/retrieved as 9223372036854776000 (float64 precision loss).
items.contract_hint: Weaviate docs: int datatype is int64; MaxInt64 must round-trip exactly.
items.manual_reason: Response serialization (JSON number) may itself lose precision before/independent of storage; need to distinguish storage truncation from JSON read/write round-trip loss.

items.title: blob accepts long non-base64 garbage string without validation

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a blob property.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of schema creation

probe_cases.desc: Insert object with a 100-char string of 'x' as blob_field (syntactically base64 alphabet but garbage bytes).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and whether object created/stored

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because blob must be valid base64-encoded data. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 stores the garbage string as-is.
items.contract_hint: Weaviate docs: blob datatype is a 'base64 encoded string'; garbage that decodes to meaningless bytes should be rejected.
items.manual_reason: The string is syntactically valid base64 (length multiple of 4, allowed alphabet); whether it 'should' be rejected is a semantic judgment that may vary by server logic. Use a string with an invalid trailing length / invalid padding to make an unambiguous invalid case.

items.title: date accepts year 0000 and pre-1970 values without proper RFC3339 validation

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a date property.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of schema creation

probe_cases.desc: Insert object with date_field="0000-01-01T00:00:00Z" (year 0000, invalid per ISO 8601).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug)

probe_cases.desc: Insert object with date_field="1800-06-15T08:30:00Z" (pre-epoch date, negative timestamp).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug)

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 for year 0000 (RFC 3339/ISO 8601 requires year 0001-9999); pre-1970 at minimum should be flagged. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 both accepted.
items.contract_hint: date datatype documented as RFC3339; RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 forbids year 0000; pre-epoch values risk timestamp overflow.

items.title: phoneNumber.defaultCountry accepts invalid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code "ZZ"

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a phoneNumber property.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of schema creation

probe_cases.desc: Insert object with phone.defaultCountry="ZZ" (not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and whether object created

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because "ZZ" is not a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (reserved user-assigned). Actual (bug): HTTP 200 stores it and processes phone number.
items.contract_hint: phoneNumber.defaultCountry documented as 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code'; ZZ is not assigned to any country.

items.title: phoneNumber.input accepts alphabetic characters like "CALL-NOW" without validation

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a phoneNumber property.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of schema creation

probe_cases.desc: Insert object with phone.input="+1-555-CALL-NOW" (contains alphabetic chars).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and response body

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because phone Number input is documented as 'normalized and validated' and alphabetic chars are not digits. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 stores raw alphabetic input.
items.contract_hint: phoneNumber input documented 'is normalized and validated'; raw alphabetic 'CALL'/'NOW' should be rejected or normalized to digits.
items.manual_reason: Some phone systems intentionally allow letter mnemonics and convert them; whether rejection is required is a judgment call that may vary. Verify against actual server behavior.

items.title: GraphQL queries accept negative limit values

probe_cases.desc: Create class TestLimit with a text property and insert two objects (name item1, item2).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 400 limit must be greater than 0)

probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and returned data

probe_cases.desc: Bug: GraphQL Get { TestLimit(limit: -100) } accepted with 200.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and returned data

items.expectation: Expected 400 for negative limit, consistent with limit=0 and limit=2.5 rejection. Actual (bug): limit=-1 and -100 return 200.

items.title: Tenant creation accepts empty string for activityStatus

probe_cases.desc: Create a multi-tenancy-enabled class TestTenant.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.desc: Control: create tenant with activityStatus="ACTIVE" (valid).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200)

probe_cases.desc: Bug: create tenant with activityStatus="" (empty string).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and whether tenant created

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because activityStatus must be one of ACTIVE/INACTIVE. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 creates tenant with empty activityStatus.
items.contract_hint: OpenAPI tenant creation endpoint defines activityStatus enum (ACTIVE/INACTIVE); empty string violates it. Other enum fields (vectorIndexType) reject invalid values with 422.

items.title: PQ bitCompression accepts string "true" instead of requiring boolean true

probe_cases.desc: Create class with pq.bitCompression set to string "true" (not boolean true).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug); then GET /v1/schema/TestClass and read vectorIndexConfig.pq.bitCompression (coerced to boolean?)

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because string "true" is not a valid boolean. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 and the string is silently coerced to boolean true.
items.contract_hint: OpenAPI and docs define pq.bitCompression as boolean; string "true" is a type-confused value. Note a non-empty string coerces truthy, so "false" would also become true.
items.manual_reason: Result may depend on the JSON decoding library's coercion behavior; ambiguous whether coercion to true is the intended server behavior. Add a follow-up case passing "false" to confirm truthiness-based coercion.

items.title: text property accepts strings containing NUL bytes (\x00) without validation

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a text property.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status of schema creation

probe_cases.desc: Insert object whose text_field contains a literal NUL byte (\x00) in the middle ('hello\\x00world'), sent as raw body via printf|curl --data-binary.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug) and body

probe_cases.desc: If accepted, retrieve the object and inspect text_field for silent truncation at the NUL byte.
probe_cases.observe: properties.text_field value (does it end at 'hello'?)

items.expectation: Expected HTTP 422 because NUL byte is unsafe for text content. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 stores the NUL byte, risking silent truncation during tokenization/indexing.
items.contract_hint: text should hold valid printable text; NUL (U+0000) is a control char that truncates in C-string paths and can corrupt the inverted index (CWE-158).
items.manual_reason: Whether a raw NUL byte in JSON is parsed/forwarded at all depends on the HTTP client and server JSON parsing; must confirm actual bytes reach the API and are stored. Index-truncation impact also needs a query to verify.

items.title: Text property accepts strings containing lone UTF-16 surrogates

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a text property TestText.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.desc: Control: insert object with normal text 'hello world'.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.desc: Insert object whose text_field contains the lone UTF-16 surrogate escape \ud800 (ill-formed per RFC 8259), sent as raw body.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug)

items.expectation: Expected 400/422 because lone surrogates are ill-formed JSON per RFC 8259. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 accepts the lone surrogate.
items.contract_hint: RFC 8259 sections 7/8.1: lone UTF-16 surrogates are ill-formed and must not be transmitted; Go encoding/json normally rejects them.
items.manual_reason: Whether a \ud800 escape is even accepted/forwarded depends on the client and server JSON parser; must verify the raw escape reaches the API regardless of local decode. Retrieval may error or self-corrupt downstream.

items.title: Text property accepts strings containing ASCII control characters (SOH, STX, ETX)

probe_cases.desc: Create schema with a text property TestText.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.desc: Insert object whose text_field embeds ASCII control bytes \x01\x02\x03 ('abc\x01\x02\x03def'), sent raw.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug)

items.expectation: Expected 422 or sanitization of raw control characters (RFC 8259 requires escaping them). Actual (bug): HTTP 200 stores raw control chars, polluting the index.
items.contract_hint: RFC 8259 section 7 requires C0 control chars in JSON strings to be escaped; raw control bytes are non-printable and pollute indexes.
items.manual_reason: curl/HTTP layer behavior on raw control bytes in body varies; must verify the control bytes actually reach and are stored by the API.

items.title: POST /v1/batch/objects accepts empty vector `[]` and reports per-item SUCCESS (singular POST /v1/objects rejects with 422)

probe_cases.desc: Create class BatchVectorBugRepro (vectorizer=none, hnsw, distance=cosine) with no properties.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.desc: CONTROL: singular POST /v1/objects with vector=[] should return 422.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 422)

probe_cases.desc: BUG: batch with a valid item (vector length 4) plus an empty-vector item; inspect per-item result.status.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 200 per bug); inspect each item's result.status (both SUCCESS?)

items.expectation: Batch item with vector=[] must surface a per-item FAILED (or whole request 422), never per-item SUCCESS. Actual (bug): HTTP 200 and both items report result.status=SUCCESS. This issue is labeled FP_BY_DESIGN (false positive) by maintainers.
items.contract_hint: data_types.vector documented as non-empty float array (min_length=1); singular POST enforces vector:[] -> 422; batch path reports SUCCESS for empty-vector item.

items.title: Batch delete returns HTTP 500 instead of 422 when match.where or match.class is missing

probe_cases.desc: Create a class BoundaryTestBatchDelete.
probe_cases.observe: HTTP 200

probe_cases.desc: Case A: batch delete with match.class present but match.where missing (where is required).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 500 per bug with 'validate: empty match.where clause')

probe_cases.desc: Case B: empty match object (both class and where missing).
probe_cases.observe: HTTP status (expect 500 per bug with 'validate: empty match.class clause')

items.expectation: Expected 422 (or 400) because missing required match.class/match.where is a client validation error. Actual (bug): HTTP 500 with 'validate: empty match.where clause' / 'empty match.class clause'.
items.contract_hint: Batch delete docs mark match.class and match.where as required; 'validate:' message prefix shows it is internally a validation error but returns 500, breaking client retry logic.
